sections.title: The Langley *game room*

items.title: Multi-Sport SimBay
items.text: Golf, soccer, hockey, baseball and more on an interactive simulator. Hourly rates with drink service at your bay; guests 12 and up, walk-ins welcome when it’s free.

items.title: Pool & games
items.text: Two pool tables, pinball and claw machines: classic bar games in a modern room.

items.title: Wall of TVs
items.text: NFL, NBA, NCAA, Premier League and more, with game sound on for the big matchups.

items.title: A bar right there
items.text: The lounge bar serves cold beer, quick cocktails and game-day snacks without leaving your game.

sections.title: Your week *at Langley*
sections.intro: No reservations needed. Planning a birthday, team outing or party? Call to book the game room or a SimBay.

items.text: Great food and service. They have a sports simulator and two pool tables as well. Full bar and several beers on tap. The grilled chicken sandwich was very tender and juicy. Great experience and plan to be back soon!
This restaurant is a gem. All our food was delicious. The service was attentive, without hovering. I really enjoyed the overall atmosphere, from the wall art to the chandelier lighting.

sections.title: Throwing a party?
sections.text: Book the game room or a SimBay for birthdays, team outings and nights out.
